text: Hitachi, Ltd.'s annual securities report for the fiscal year ended 31 March 2026 lists Hitachi High-Tech Corporation among its principal subsidiaries, with 100.0% of the voting rights.
short: Hitachi High-Tech Corporation is a wholly owned subsidiary of Hitachi, Ltd.

source.name: Hitachi, Ltd.: Annual Securities Report (The 157th Business Term), April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2026, Note 27 'Principal Subsidiaries'
source.note: English translation of the report filed on June 22, 2026; a 51 MB PDF, so the source check can't read it. Note 27 starts on page F-71.

additionalSources.name: Hitachi, Ltd.: List of Group Companies (the data file behind hitachi.com/en/about/group/)
additionalSources.note: The directory marks Hitachi High-Tech Corporation as a consolidated subsidiary; the file says 'Updated: July 29, 2026'.
